name: Robert Z.
preview: Sarah: The price — say more. What's good

messages.text: Hey Robert — Sarah here, thanks for hopping on. I saw you've been around the site for a few months now, with a couple orders in and some newer stuff like the NEXUS L1 catching your eye lately. I'd just love to hear what's been on your mind — where should we start?
Yeah. Just, uh, in general, shopping. Just like shopping in general.

Got it — just browsing in general. Let me pull up the one that's been catching your eye lately. Actually — let me pull up the NEXUS L1 since you've been back to it a bunch of times the last week or so.
Yeah? What about it makes it a good one for you?
The price — say more. What's good
